seeds.why: Pre-#1269 endpoint handling: archive._s3_endpoint_canonical hands the endpoint back as given, so archive.configure stores 'http://minio:9000/' with its slash and both signers, which append '/' || bucket to it, address '//<bucket>/<key>'. MinIO answers HTTP 400 to every PUT, so every export and every tick's chunk through it fails after the read. One clause, the strip. tests/archive/db/53 parts B and E catch it (the stored endpoint keeps the slash, the export fails, its object never lands, and both signers' GET through the slashed endpoint is refused).
